rows.text:
The user wants an extended, detailed engineering tutorial on designing a reliable service based on the provided document. The document is extremely repetitive, essentially just saying: "A reliable service records requests, validates inputs, processes jobs and handles failures." repeated many times.

I need to write a comprehensive engineering tutorial (at least 1500 words) covering:
1. Designing this service
2. Examples
3. Failure analysis
4. Testing

Structure should be:
- Introduction/Overview
- Core Requirements (derived from the document)
- Architecture/High-Level Design
- Component Deep Dives:
  - Request Recording/Ing
